name: audit-trail
description: Writes every action Claude takes to an append-only JSONL audit log.

directory.title: Log directory
directory.description: Where the daily JSONL files go. Relative paths start at the project root; a leading ~/ is your home folder.

prompts.title: Prompt logging
prompts.description: hash: log a SHA-256 of each prompt, never its text. text: log the prompt itself (secrets redacted, cut at 2,000 characters). none: log only its length.
